units: mm, g, deg (internal manifest joint convention: q = firmware_deg - 90 with manifest sign)

mass_model.status: provisional-nominal — weigh the real robot and parts (NEEDS-HARDWARE)
mass_model.servo_note: MG90S nominal from manifest/robot.yaml; SG90 is about 9 g
mass_model.battery_note: S3 build pack (B0F3JB59B6, 47 g listing) at the V3 kit's battery_mount envelope — NEEDS-HARDWARE
mass_model.pla_note: solid PLA is 1.24; small upstream parts with default walls/infill assumed ~77 %

walking_rom.note: union of walk / walk_backward / turn_left / turn_right / stand / rest in manifest/motions.yaml

print_ties.note: print-only membrane filling the four knee slots (shell-dome-print.stl); cut out after printing

shell.stiffness_note: 2026-11-17: thickness 1.3 -> 1.6, min_web 4 -> 5 (2.0 / 6 lifted the CoM so far that the arm seats left the rim; 1.8 failed the CoM-error rest depth, 0.227 > 0.2 mm; 1.7 passed at 0.163) after the PLA dome turned to spaghetti; the 1.3 mm lattice petals swayed under the nozzle
shell.variant_note: v3-headarms = support-free ogive dome with two rim lugs, locked by a twist (bayonet) into two arms grown from the sides of a new head cover (kit head cover + arms, printed with supports, screwed to the frame by its 4 corner screws). Kit lid unchanged; no crown, stem or key; the apex stays smooth.

rim_band.note: 2026-11-26: wall thickened inward from the rim to z 50 (45-degree step back): the 1.6 mm side petals splayed and the printed dome was ~1 cm too wide for the arms, so the lugs barely caught

acceptance.max_other_rest_depth_note: 2026-11-11: non-belly rests that need < 0.2 mm of CoM rise to leave (vs ~14 mm belly) are accepted; they appear only with the +-3 mm CoM perturbation. MuJoCo drop/recovery stay the functional check.

body.note: Loftwork V3 frame kit adapted for the APS carrier (reference/frame-and-cover_261105). Legs unchanged, hip axes at the kit datums.

electronics.name: carrier-components
electronics.note: S3 SuperMini, PCA9685 hub, LM2596, OLED, plugs inside the head; mass estimated, box only for CoM/protection

body.pla_parts_note: kit head-cover stays in the body model; the added arms are a shell part (head-arms) with CAD mass; print head-mount.stl (head + arms) instead of the kit head-cover

fit_check.note: dome prints rim-down without supports; head-mount prints rim-down WITH supports (arms, ledges), like the kit head cover

head_arms.note: per side (y = +-), in the leg-free side corridor |x| <= 10 between the front and rear hips, above the servo ribbons (z <= ~31)

root.note: half_w 10 -> 6.5: the front femurs came within 3.9 mm of the block's corner (x 10.9) at hip -2.5 deg

web.note: bottom 34 -> 44 (top 48 -> 56): at hip -10 deg (walk) the front femurs reach x ~10.4 up to z ~42 beside the web around y 34-62; the web now passes above them

tip.note: 2026-11-26: channel moved 3.6 mm inward and ledge 3.4 -> 6.0: radial lug engagement 2.9 -> 5.5 mm; y_out 89.6 -> 88.8 to stay inside the thicker rim

head_arms.twist_note: lower the dome turned -twist_deg about z (seen from above), then turn it +twist_deg: the lugs slide under the ledges, click over the detent and stop at the stop wall
